answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 29276 Country: India Title: Should i marry a daughter of servant of the bank? as much i know the indulging in any activity of interest is not allowed however current system of banking is totally depends upon interest. SO what is the guidance of quran 0 hadees in this problem? Question: Should i marry a daughter of servant of the bank? as much i know the indulging in any activity of interest is not allowed however current system of banking is totally depends upon interest. SO what is the guidance of quran 0 hadees in this problem? Answer ID: 29276 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 182/182/M=1432) It is not unlawful to marry the daughter of a bank employee. If one does not marry on the ground of his impure earning , it is the the highiest level of precaution. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
